svg.title: Appendix A3: how database monitoring tools get their data
svg.desc: Five tools read in their public docs: they run SQL on statistics views at an interval and carry aggregates or normalized query shapes. CDC reads the write-ahead log and carries the change itself. This is a reading of documentation, not a test; CDC cost versus polling is not measured.

svg.text: CDC is not free: a slow consumer makes the replication slot retain WAL (measured). Its cost against polling is not measured.
